description: Dostupnost zastávek MHD a VLD v Olomouckém kraji is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Olomoucký kraj. Analysis of the availability of public infrastructure in the Olomouc Region 2024 - public transport stops (municipal public transport) and VLD (public regular transport). Coverage: Olomoucký kraj. The portal shows the English title as "Availability of public transport and VLD stops in the Olomouc Region" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Olomoucký kraj. Its keywords include opendata, Dostupnost, územní plánování, Olomoucký kraj, dopravní infrastruktura. The listing shows 6 download or service links in KML, HTML, ZIP, GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/60609460/f0a4cb88d6b6f524c4d76e18d4d641bd/distribuce/b007cde5d9735b5719290ca757ac0019/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
